positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: I helped build and ship Nexus, AllCode's internal tool for deploying AWS and Claude Code configuration to client machines, which involved building a Windows installer from scratch, fixing cross-platform bugs, and getting it working reliably across multiple client organizations in production. I also worked on Dark Factory, a multi-agent AI software development system utilizing autonomous Planner, Coder, Reviewer, and Merger agents. Alongside that, I contributed to an AI sales outreach agent to research and score leads and generate personalized emails and texts, integrating it with CRMs like HubSpot and Airtable. Overall, I gained hands-on experience designing, debugging, and deploying real AI systems in production, making them usable by non-technical teams.

positions.title: Board Member
positions.description: As secretary and head of technology, I serve as one of the 5 directors that work together to make decisions for Powering Tomorrow, a 501(c)(3) non-profit that educates elementary and middle-school students about energy science, the causes and effect of climate change, and how students make better energy choices. The Green Energy Challenge Workshop, is offered to over 3,000 students across 30 San Francisco schools.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: I worked as a software engineer intern that leveraged AI to build prototypes for Collections and Sales. Used various AI's including Base44 cursor in order to develop apps that clients had requested. Extensive use of Amazon Q to build products using Supabase, Elastic Beanstalk, Node.js, S3, and React. Also, wrote SDK libraries in Perl, Python, Ruby, .Net, and Node to build out development kits to enable client engineers to use the REST API without having to use Postman. Built a Shopify store for CloudContact AI, which is AllCode's product.
positions.insights: Software Industry, Internet Software and +1 skill

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.locationName: Walnut Creek, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: Working under Hin Lee, I gained skills in virtualization, becoming proficient with advanced tools like Proxmox and Docker. As one of my responsibilities, I was directed to set-up, configure, and document a Proxmox backup server. I also gained skills in wifi/computer network management and ultimately managed my own small network.
